intro: The Lean coffee table helps you create a home that feels open and inviting. Its generous compartments and modern design ensures your living room stays stylish and clutter-free.

features.title: Roomy shelves for your essentials
features.text: Display your favourite décor on a stylish overhang shelf that turns everyday storage into a visual feature.

features.title: Drawers that keep essentials handy
features.text: Sleek and minimal, our table offers accessible storage on both sides, blending function with understated elegance.

features.title: Dual-tone finish adds modern charm
features.text: Blend it right in—Silver Oak and Pebble Stone tones complement contemporary interiors effortlessly.

features.title: Sleek design fits close to walls
features.text: Corners, open walls, or tucked beside your sofa—our adaptable design moves with you, giving you flexibility without compromising on style.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
